note: Both sets are numerically accurate against Table 6-1, with values correctly bound to rows and columns. Set A, however, pads its output with eleven near-trivial claims (ten identical 0.0 m cg-offset entries plus a bare elevation entry), uses vague ellipsis quotes for several of them, mislabels TwFAStif as "forward-aft stiffness," and omits the side-to-side inertia column entirely. Set B covers a broader mix of properties (mass density, FA/SS stiffness, torsional and axial stiffness, both inertias, cg offsets) with fuller, row-specific quotes and only eight trivial entries, so it carries more useful information with less noise.
